popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Pseudo-Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Epopeus of Sicyon takes in Antiope fleeing Nycteus; the war that follows ends with Lycus killing the king who sheltered Zeus' beloved.

popCulture.title: Antiope (mythology)
popCulture.description: Theban princess whose flight to Sicyon and marriage to Epopeus ignites the Nycteid war — Epopeus as her mortal protector-king.

popCulture.title: Epopeus
popCulture.description: King of Sicyon who married Antiope — distinct from other Epopeus figures of myth.
